name: Zichri
overview: Zichri was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Jeremoth. His mention is brief and rooted in genealogical records, emphasizing his heritage within the Benjaminite lineage as recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:27.
namesAndTitles: The name Zichri means "YHWH remembers," reflecting a theologically rich meaning tied to God's faithfulness. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a significant reminder of divine remembrance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zichri as the son of Jeremoth, establishing a clear father-son relationship within the tribe of Benjamin. No additional familial relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Zichri's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, contributing to the biblical record of Israel's tribal families. His identification as the son of Jeremoth serves to preserve the lineage and heritage important for understanding the people of Israel in the Old Testament context.
